title: Code of Practice on Transparency and Marking of AI-generated Content under Article 50(2) and (4) of the AI Act
short_title: Article 50 Marking and Labelling Code of Practice (forthcoming)
citation: Code of Practice under Article 50(2) and (4) AI Act
notes: Forthcoming Code of Practice referenced in the draft Article 50 Guidelines. Co-regulatory instrument: adherence to an adopted Code creates a presumption of compliance with Articles 50(2) and (4). Modeled as a separate Instrument; when Terms are available, they will anchor to the relevant Article Terms (eu-ai-act-art-50-2, eu-ai-act-art-50-4) using the same anchors pattern as the Guidelines. issuedBy set to the Commission authority pending confirmation of the precise issuing body.
